name: Victoria Park Market
summary: A weekly Sunday produce market inside Victoria Park, run by the Good Market Company and started in June 2017 as a six-month summer project.

story.opened: June 2017, started as a six-month summer project.
story.then: What began as a short summer trial has become, in Secret London's words, a vital part of Tower Hamlets life.
story.now: Sets up on the pedestrianised Nightwalk inside the park, between Bonner Gate and Gore Gate. Food stalls cover cheese, charcuterie, burgers and burritos, among much else.
worth_knowing: The Good Market Company, which runs it, says it wants markets that pair quality produce with businesses that have a positive social impact.
